name: MajlisAlpha UAE Customer Signal Room
purpose: Convert pilot conversations into product evidence by tracking real questions, repeat usage, objections, paid intent, coverage demand, and roadmap decisions.
signalPolicy: No feedback item should become roadmap work unless user segment, evidence, impact, frequency, and next decision are recorded.

signalTypes.description: A user brings a UAE market question from their own workflow.
signalTypes.strongSignal: Question includes ticker, source need, decision context, and follow-up request.

signalTypes.description: A user asks additional questions, uploads sources, exports briefs, or saves watchlists.
signalTypes.strongSignal: User returns without prompting or asks how to keep access.

signalTypes.description: A user asks about price, plan, team access, invoice, or launch timing.
signalTypes.strongSignal: User accepts a pilot price or introduces another decision maker.

signalTypes.description: A user questions source quality, traceability, freshness, or model confidence.
signalTypes.strongSignal: Objection points to a specific missing source, claim, or audit workflow.

signalTypes.description: A user requests new issuer, sector, alert, export, integration, or region support.
signalTypes.strongSignal: Multiple users request the same coverage with clear use case.

decisionRules.criteria: Repeated signal from target users with clear revenue or retention impact.
Interesting signal with unclear frequency, buyer, or workflow impact.
Single comment, compliment, or vague feature idea without evidence.
Request would weaken source integrity, compliance posture, or product focus.

metrics: roadmap items backed by repeated demand

launchGate.readyRule: Customer Signal Room is pilot-ready when every roadmap decision links to user segment, feedback evidence, frequency, owner, and mission-control task.
launchGate.blockedRule: Do not build from praise alone; require repeated demand, paid intent, or a specific trust objection.
